title: CAVD_GSEA: transcriptomic and gene-set enrichment analyses of calcific aortic valve disease
description:
Reproducible transcriptomic analyses and microscopy processing code supporting the study of leptin, autophagy, lipid storage and osteogenic differentiation in human aortic valve interstitial cells. This release includes the frozen GSEA plans and implementation, curated gene sets, 68 GSEA results, public GEO retrieval and reproduction records, together with the microscopy measurement macros and statistical companion scripts added to GitHub in October 2026.

Version 1.1.0 removes obsolete journal-specific wording from the VIC-characterization plotting entry point and updates the manuscript-location documentation. The archived GSEA Figure 1 corresponds to Supplementary Figure S10 in the revised manuscript; historical output filenames are preserved. The repository does not generate the complete revised nine-figure manuscript layout.

No measurement algorithms, filtering rules, numerical constants, saved output names, experimental images or scientific results were changed in this cleanup. Syntax, normalized computational structure and publication-file checksums were checked. A new biological analysis or complete microscopy rerun was not performed. The prior GSEA validation and limitations remain documented.

Code is licensed under MIT. Author-created data, figures and scientific documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Third-party resources retain their original terms. Microscopy source images and other wet-laboratory source data are not included in this code archive.
